arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# Final structural validation replicating public_check.py exactly.
import stat
from pathlib import Path
project = Path('/workspace/project').absolute()
assert not project.is_symlink() and project.is_dir()
total = 0
entries = 0
for path in project.rglob("*"):
    info = path.lstat()
    entries += 1
    if path.is_symlink() or not (stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)):
        raise ValueError("project contains a non-regular entry")
    if stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
        if info.st_nlink != 1:
            raise ValueError("project contains a hard link")
        total += info.st_size
assert total <= 8 * 1024 * 1024 and entries <= 256
candidate = project / "campaign_cli.py"
candidate.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
print("submission bounds OK: %d entries, %d bytes" % (entries, total))
PYEOF
ls -R project | head -20; echo; echo "=== final end-to-end ==="; cd project && python3 tests/selftest.py | tail -1 && python3 tests/differential.py
